_comment: What the Soul Creation wizard can hand out, checked again by backend/character_creation.py when a character is saved. The wizard reads the age, budget and profession numbers from here (app/main/welcome/soul-creation/SoulCreation.tsx, app/lib/ageScaling.ts); genders, races and birthsigns mirror app/lib/characterOptions.ts (compared by tests/test_character_creation.py). Ages are human-equivalent months (races only scale the displayed age).

group._comment: Body (Might, Agility, Endurance, Precision) and Soul (Will, Insight, Lore, Presence) each hold this many points; the wizard's split runs from min/max to max/min

bodySoulSum._comment: How many points Body and Soul share, by age: atOldest at the oldest age, peak at peakAt (0 = oldest, 1 = youngest), atYoungest at the youngest, linear in between

professions._comment: One profession at first, a second from 51 human years, a third from 61; the slots fill in order and no two professions come from the same group

races._comment: race -> its group (the raceGroup a character is saved with)
